name: Abyssal Scepters
label: Quest
description: Abyssal Scepters: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've truly exceeded all my expectations, friend. You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.
At this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer and their overlords.
Bring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew you'd come through, friend! Here's your reward.
